// Negative control (#5170): every shape the guard forbids, written the sanctioned way. Must scan clean.
import { gateVerdict, gateUnreadable } from './gate-verdict.cjs';
import { readTextEvidence, evidenceFound, evidenceFromError, verdictFromEvidence } from './gate-evidence.cjs';
import type { Evidence } from './gate-evidence.cjs';
import { declareGateExit } from './gate-exit.cjs';
import { output, error } from './io.cjs';

function parseJson(text: string, span: string): Evidence<unknown> {
  try {
    return evidenceFound(JSON.parse(text) as unknown);
  } catch (err) {
    return evidenceFromError<unknown>(err, span);
  }
}

export function evaluateFixtureGate(planPath: string) {
  return verdictFromEvidence(readTextEvidence(planPath), {
    found: (text) => gateVerdict('pass', false, { text }),
    none: () => gateVerdict('skip', false, { reason: 'no plan' }),
    unreadable: (reason) => gateUnreadable(true, { reason }),
  });
}

export function cmdFixtureVerb(run: () => void, raw: boolean): void {
  try {
    run();
    output({ passed: true }, raw);
    declareGateExit({ outcome: 'pass' }, 'status');
  } catch (err) {
    output({ block: false, message: 'exception: ' + String(err) }, raw);
    declareGateExit({ outcome: 'unreadable' }, 'status');
  }
}

export function cmdFixtureFailing(raw: boolean): void {
  try {
    parseJson('{}', 'x');
  } catch (err) {
    error('could not run: ' + String(err));
  }
  output({}, raw);
}
